data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish word dolores, which means sorrows or pains. Delores is a female name in Christianity, particularly associated with the Virgin Mary, as she bore the pains and sorrows of giving birth to Jesus Christ. The name Delores carries the meaning “Dolores in Spanish = Sorrows” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Delores usually hope their child will grow to embody dolores in spanish = sorrows and live with faith, good character and purpose.
